turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: Atlas Auto Group / Invoca | check-in | Tue, Oct 13, 2026

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Morning, both. Can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yep, loud and clear.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Good morning, [PERSON_1]. I've got the BDC numbers open already, so I'm ready.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. How's the service-drive volume looking the last couple weeks?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Up a bit. We're seeing more service calls than sales calls at most of the stores now, which is a shift from where we were in the spring.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Service has been the steady one. Sales is up and down depending on the month.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And the BDC appointment-set rate, still around where we left it?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Thirty-four percent, give or take. It bounces between stores. The Nevada rooftops run a little lower than Phoenix.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. Is that the number you're holding the managers to?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: It's the one I report. Whether they look at it is a different question.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Before we get too far into the weeds, there's something I want to put on the table.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Go ahead.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Marchex came in last week and quoted us about forty dollars less per rooftop per month. That's real money across twenty-two stores.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Understood. When does that quote run through?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: They gave us until the end of the month to decide. I told them we'd look at it. I'm not saying we're moving, I'm saying I have to bring it to the table.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's fair. I'd rather hear it from you now than in November. Can you send me what they scoped? I want to see what's actually in the per-rooftop number.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I can forward it. It's a one-pager, not much detail.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Send it over and I'll get it in front of the right people on our side. I'm not going to negotiate against myself on this call.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Appreciate that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Can I jump in on something related? It's about the Google Ads side.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Please.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Our appointment-set conversions aren't hitting Google Ads until two days later, sometimes three.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Two to three days. Is that from the time the call happens, or from the time the BDC marks the appointment?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: From when the appointment actually gets set. The call comes in, the agent books it, and then it's a while before it shows up on the Google side.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And you're looking at it where, in the Google Ads UI?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: In the conversions column, yeah. We've been comparing it to what we see on our end and the lag is pretty consistent.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Got it. How are you marking the appointment-set in Salesforce right now, is it on the lead or on a call record?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: On the lead. The BDC sets the status and that's what we're keying off.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. I want to check how that's flowing through to the conversion upload. I don't want to guess at it on the call.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That's fine. I just need to know if it's something on our end or yours.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I'll find out which it is and come back to you. Is the lag hurting anything specific, or is it more of a reporting annoyance?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: It's bidding. [PERSON_2]'s team makes budget calls on that data and if it's three days stale, they're making calls on old news.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: It's not the end of the world, but it does make the weekly optimization meeting awkward.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Noted. Anything else on the Google side while we're here?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: No, that's the main one. The rest of it's been fine.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. What about the scorecards, are the managers using those?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Some of them. That's actually the other thing I wanted to bring up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Go on.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: If I could get the BDC scorecard dashboard into Google Sheets automatically, my managers would actually look at it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: So today you're pulling it manually?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I export it every Monday and paste it into a sheet. It takes me about an hour and by Wednesday half of them haven't opened it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And if it just showed up in the sheet on its own, that would solve it?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I think so. They live in Sheets. If it's already there when they sit down Monday morning, they'll use it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Let me ask around on that. I don't want to promise you a date I can't hold.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That's all I'm asking.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: While you're at it, is there anything on our side we're not using that we should be?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Nothing that jumps out. Your tracking and the signals are set up the way I'd want them.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. I don't need another project right now.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Understood. Let me recap what I'm taking away. One, I'll look at the conversion timing and tell you whether it's on our end or yours. Two, I'll ask about getting the scorecard into Sheets automatically and come back with an answer either way. Three, [PERSON_2], send me the Marchex one-pager.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'll send it this afternoon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: And can you loop me in on the conversion thing when you hear back? I'd rather not chase it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: You'll be on it. I'll follow up by Friday either way, even if it's just to say I'm still digging.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Same time in two weeks?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Same time. Thanks, both.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Thanks, [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Take care.
